issues.evidence: P19_no_values_in_audit_or_stderr; `vault get b SuperSecretValue123` -> stderr 'vault: error: unrecognized arguments: SuperSecretValue123' (A/vault.py:304-305)
issues.summary: Custom argparse error handler echoes raw argv text to stderr, so a value passed as a stray argument is printed to stderr.
list shows only '***' for values of 4 chars or fewer and '[EXPIRED]' for expired entries instead of value[:4]***; defensible to avoid full disclosure but deviates from literal spec.
Exceptions re-raised in except blocks without 'from', minor lint findings.

issues.evidence: probes/concurrency.py: 8 concurrent `set` of distinct keys -> only 1 persisted, all exit 0 (no file locking around read-modify-write, shared vault.enc.tmp at B/vault.py:65-71)
issues.summary: Concurrent invocations silently lose updates because there is no locking around load/save.

issues.evidence: `env -u VAULT_MASTER_KEY vault.py list` -> 'VAULT_MASTER_KEY is not set' rc=1 (B/vault.py:113-116)
issues.summary: Missing master password is reported as a user error (exit 1) rather than auth error (exit 2).

issues.summary: Value read from stdin has all trailing newlines stripped, silently altering values.
list masking of short values reveals all but the last character (e.g. 'abcd' -> 'abc***').

issues.evidence: static/B-ruff.txt (C901 run complexity 17, B904 x3, UP031)
issues.summary: Single monolithic run() dispatcher with high complexity and minor lint findings.

blinding_guess.why: B ships a test suite which hints at a more process-driven workflow, but both implementations are similarly structured and spec-aware.

notes: Of the 24 spec probes, B passes all and A fails only P19; expiry probes rewrite the encrypted vault (salt located by scanning small header offsets, so A's 4-byte magic prefix and B's bare salt are treated identically). Extra robustness probe P25 shows B loses concurrent writes while A serializes via flock. A has no tests; B's 14 subprocess-based tests all pass. Probes need PYTHONUSERBASE set because HOME is redirected to temp dirs.
